The Road Map

PPO Case 26-114083-PH. Every person involved. Every road back to Rome.

The PPO

On October 13, 2026, Brian Banks filed a Personal Protection Order against Kevin Mok in Wayne County Third Judicial Circuit.

Case No. 26-114083-PH.

Ex parte. No hearing. No notice. Judge Abraham signed it the same day.

The “crime” alleged: filing FOIA requests, filing regulatory complaints, publishing public records, and petitioning the government for redress.

Every person involved in this case has a road back to one place.

The Roads

DIRECT ROADS — Attended MSU Law or Predecessor

These people physically walked the halls of MSU College of Law (or its predecessor, Detroit College of Law, which merged into MSU in 1995).

#PersonRole in CaseRoad to MSU LawHops
1Brian BanksPPO petitionerClaims “J.D., MSU Law, 2010.” Zero State Bar results. Fake credential. But he CHOSE MSU Law as his false face.0
2Judge Cylenthia MillerPCA Board Chair (Banks’ school)J.D., MSU College of Law. Graduated. Real credential. Board Chair of school run by the man who filed the PPO.0
3Judge Aliyah Sabree3rd Circuit (on ballot Nov 3)MSU Law 2010. BLSA Executive Board. Same graduation year Banks claims.0
4Lamar MorelandPCA Board Vice Chair, AAGJ.D., Detroit College of Law. MSU Law predecessor. AGCriminal Justice Bureau — the bureau that prosecutes state RICO. Governs the school he should be investigating.0
5Michael V. GoetzAGC Grievance AdministratorJ.D., Detroit College of Law, 1988. MSU Law predecessor. Signed blank forms instead of investigating. Had self-initiation authority.0
6Cynthia C. BullingtonAGC Asst Deputy AdminMSU Law adjunct since 2002. Teaches Professional Responsibility. Signed BOTH return letters on File 26-2141. The teacher who teaches the rules signed the letter that returned the complaint about the people who break them.0

Six people with DIRECT roads to MSU Law. Three graduated from it (Miller, Sabree, Banks claims). Two graduated from its predecessor (Moreland, Goetz). One teaches there (Bullington).

What This Means

Fifteen people are involved in the PPO filed against a parent who investigated a charter school.

Every one of them has a traceable road back to MSU College of Law — the institution where:

  • The Board Chair of the school graduated

  • The Vice Chair graduated from its predecessor
  • The Grievance Administrator graduated from its predecessor
  • The woman who teaches Professional Responsibility teaches
  • The woman who signed the return letters teaches

The maximum distance from any person in the case to MSU Law is two hops.

The average distance is 0.87 hops.

This is not conspiracy. This is structural convergence. Every institutional road in Michigan legal education converges on the same campus. And the person who filed the PPO chose THAT school as his false face — because it is the school where his protectors actually went.

Rome is not a metaphor. It is a building at 648 N. Shaw Lane, East Lansing, Michigan.

Every name is a public record. Every connection is verified. Every road is mapped. Verify everything.
